contentHtml:
Thousands of photos scattered across old phones, memory cards and a shoebox of prints. A cupboard of ageing VHS tapes and slide carousels nobody has a player for any more. I help you declutter, organise and digitise the lot, so it is safe, easy to find, and actually enjoyed again instead of gathering dust. I help families around Stretton and Brisbane.

Unorganised photos are photos you will eventually lose

Duplicate copies spread across old phones and cloud accounts, folders with no structure, and physical photos, tapes and slides slowly fading in a cupboard. None of it is really backed up until it is in one organised, protected place.

Sort it, digitise it, back it up

  • Consolidate. I gather your photos from every device and account into one place.
  • Declutter. Duplicates removed and everything sorted into a folder structure that makes sense.
  • Digitise. Old VHS tapes, slides and printed photos scanned and converted so they last.
  • Back up. The finished collection protected with a local copy and a cloud copy, so a lost phone or a dead drive never takes your memories with it.

To keep it all protected going forward, see my data backup and transfer and cloud backup and storage services.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
